definition_of_done: Stage 3 validated checkbox checked, with numbers (not projections) in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Do not report the refactor complete before that.

validation_protocol.attack: PGD-50, norm-space eps applied directly, per-channel bound check
validation_protocol.seeds: 3-seed averaging protocol (fresh sample subset + fresh PGD init per seed), n=300/seed
validation_protocol.significance_criterion: delta > 2 * sigma_combined at eps=0.094 (pre-registered, deliberately conservative)
validation_protocol.known_caveat: cross-run GPU nondeterminism (grid_sample/attention backward) can shift identical configs by ~1.5pp; treat verdicts accordingly
